sections.text: Introduction

The three phase differential Relay type R30 is primarily intended to protect the 
following system components

items: Transformers.
Generators

sections.text:
The Relay is connected directly to main current Transformer of each feeder of 
the protected item.

The first draft is imitated and tested by 
eng. Mostafa Hasas, accepted by general director 
eng. Farag Abo Yousef, and approved by eng. Abd ElMohsen Abd El-Ghafar: 
headsector of Kafr El Dawar PS

eng. Mona Ahmed Elsharkawy: WDEPC inspection & quality control 's
head sector and MPIS coordinator.

items: Inject the current to points ( 1,19 ) for phase R for H.V side
